notes.title: Ukrainian Game Festival 2025 Demo Update
notes.notes: Demo version uploaded for Ukrainian Game Festival 2025

notes.title: "Lethal Dose" Ending Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes and corrections:[/h3]
[list]
[*] One of the endings was completely finished, namely Lethal Dose
[*] Updated/refined sounds effects
[*] Fixed some bugs, minor changes and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
[b]Changes and corrections:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tutorial for controls and gameplay mechanics added.
[*]Traces of violence have been added throughout the location.
[*]Localization added (Eng, Rus, Ua).
[*]Some bugs fixed and various other improvements made.
[/list]

notes.title: Cutscenes Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes and corrections:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added introductory cutscenes (with tutorial)
[*]Added a new fuel system for the generator
[*]Added customization of key bindings
[*]Improved main menu - visually and functionally
[*]Bug fixes and other minor improvements and changes
[/list]

notes.title: Effects Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes and corrections:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some bugs with reverb effect
[*] Added fly swarm effect in the biowaste room
[*] Added water jet effect when using sinks
[*] Added dynamic light flashing effect (also serves as an indicator for approximately the amount of fuel in the generator)
[*] Small performance optimization
[/list]
